name: SpexCode
description: The spec tree of the repository a task works in — each node's body, its drift from the code, its architecture diagram — beside the task. Start a new task on a node or cite it in this one; agents get SpexCode's skills.

zh-CN.name: SpexCode
zh-CN.description: 任务旁边一格:它所在仓库的规格树——每个节点的正文、和代码的漂移、架构图。在节点上开一条新任务,或者把节点引用进这条任务;agent 拿到 SpexCode 的技能。
examples: 给这个仓库画一份规格图
哪些规格和代码漂移了?
Draw the spec atlas of this repository
Which specs have drifted from the code?
author: SpexCode
